name: lw_50334
statement: (n : ℕ) (α : ℝ) (hn : 0 < n) (hα : α > 0 ∧ α < Real.pi / n) : (∏ i ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, (Real.sin (i * α))) < 1 / (n * (Real.sin (α / 2)) ^ n)
closed: ∀ (n : ℕ) (α : ℝ) (hn : 0 < n) (hα : α > 0 ∧ α < Real.pi / n), (∏ i ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, (Real.sin (i * α))) < 1 / (n * (Real.sin (α / 2)) ^ n)
informal: Let $n$ be a random natural number. $\alpha$ is a number such that $0 < \alpha < \frac{\pi}{n}$ . \n $$sin\alpha sin 2\alpha\cdots sin n\alpha < \frac{1}{n sin^n \frac{\alpha}{2}}$$
type: ∀ (n : ℕ) (α : ℝ), 0 < n → α > 0 ∧ α < Real.pi / ↑n → ∏ i ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, Real.sin (↑i * α) < 1 / (↑n * Real.sin (α / 2) ^ n)
